h: Umahi asks why Igbos should get only four years when others have done eight
p: Works Minister David Umahi has responded to Peter Obi's position on a South-East presidential term, asking why Igbos should be limited to four years when others have served eight. His comment adds to a growing debate over zoning and an Igbo presidency ahead of 2027.
more: The comment follows Anambra governor Charles Soludo's remark that backing Tinubu could open the door to an Igbo president.
